name: tool_dispatch_retry
py_module: (policy — consumer of tool_classify_error; self-contained parity gate)
notes: Proves the agent loop's retry POLICY (the concrete consumer of tool_classify_error): transient error -> re-dispatch up to TOOL_RETRY_MAX; permanent/unknown/success -> no retry; transient-then-success -> stop. Uses the REAL classifier (links tool_result_classification.c). This is what makes the P1 idempotency cache + classification non-speculative: the loop now actually retries transient tool errors, and registry_dispatch's omap-backed cache makes those retries safe (no double side effect).
